verdict.rationale: Customer.io sends email, so authenticating a sending domain is an applicable axis. However, the evidence pack never mentions SPF, DKIM, DMARC, DNS records or domain verification flows. The closest items are account verification at signup, which reviews the company website and domain for use-case vetting, and agent-run deliverability reports; neither is sending-domain authentication.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can authenticate my own sending domain — SPF, DKIM, DMARC alignment — with guided DNS setup and verification
